places.name: Atlanta State Park
places.coord_point: official TPWD park coordinates (park address 927 Park Road 42, Atlanta, TX)
places.blurb: Pines and hardwoods on the shore of Wright Patman Lake, with full hookup and electric sites that allow tents.
places.notes: NAME CANDIDATES (ten, from the brief's rule): Meridian, Azimuth, Umbra, Equinox, Solstice, Perihelion, Almucantar, Zodiac, Nadir, Starling. Chosen: Almucantar. COORDINATES: TPWD page prints Latitude 33.230731, Longitude -94.249693 (used, rounded to 5 dp). Wikipedia infobox point 33.23194, -94.24944 agrees (about 0.13 km away). ACRES 1,475 from Wikipedia infobox (TPWD page prints no acreage). COUNTY Cass per Wikipedia infobox. CAMPING: TPWD campsites tab lists Full Hookup 50-amp and 30-amp sites and electric 50-amp and 30-amp sites, all with tent pads, up to two tents per site; no cabins or primitive sites on that tab. camping_kinds tent and rv_hookups. RESERVATIONS: the ReserveAmerica facility link is the one printed on the TPWD page. STATUS: TPWD page carries a firewood quarantine note for emerald ash borer (not a closure). NEARBY: distances are great-circle from the coordinates above; Daingerfield and Caddo Lake coordinates are Wikipedia, not official. DARK SKY: not on the two DarkSky pages I could read (the all-places list and the Texas-filtered finder); both load only their first page in static HTML, so absence is not proof. LP: no official SQM or Bortle figure printed on the TPWD page, so null. The town of Atlanta is about 9 mi from the park.

places.name: Caprock Canyons State Park and Trailway
places.blurb: Red-rock canyons under the Caprock escarpment, a bison herd, a rail-trail and a night sky now certified by DarkSky.
places.notes: COORDINATES: the TPWD page prints Latitude 34.410296, Longitude -101.053264 (used). The Wikipedia infobox point 34.44361, -101.05222 is about 3.7 km north of it, which is outside the 2 km tolerance, so the official point was used and the gap is recorded here. ACRES: Wikipedia infobox gives 17,500 acres; the DarkSky release says 'more than 15,000 acres'; the Wikipedia figure is used. DARK SKY: the DarkSky place page shows 'Designated' with a date of November 25, 2025, and the DarkSky press release is dated November 25, 2025, so year 2025. CAMPING: TPWD campsites tab lists 50-amp and 30-amp electric sites (Honey Flat); walk-in water sites at Lake Theo (the tab does not say tent-only); primitive tent-only walk-in sites (Little Red, South Prong); hike-in primitive sites in the North and South Prong areas and along the Trailway; a horse-site tab. TPWD page shows 'This park has active alerts'; I did not read the alert text.

places.name: Eisenhower State Park
places.coord_point: official TPWD park coordinates (50 Park Road 20, Denison, TX)
places.blurb: Lake Texoma shoreline park with full hookup and electric sites, tent pads and screened shelters.
places.notes: COORDINATES: TPWD page prints Latitude 33.810339, Longitude -96.599971 (used). ACRES 423.1 and COUNTY Grayson from the Wikipedia article 'Eisenhower State Park (Texas)'. CAMPING: TPWD campsites tab lists Full Hookup sites (water, sewer, electric), electric sites (water and electric), tent-pad sites in the Elm Point area with a water spigot, tent-pad sites in the Armadillo Hill and Fossil Ridge areas, and a Screened Shelters heading. NEARBY: Lake Texoma is a reservoir, not a town; distances are great-circle from the coordinates, Denison from the Wikipedia point. DARK SKY and LP: no designation found on the DarkSky pages I could read (see Atlanta notes), and no official light-pollution figure on the TPWD page, so null.

places.name: Goose Island State Park
nearby: Fulton Mansion State Historic Site (6 mi)
places.blurb: Oak-shaded coastal park with bayfront electric sites, walk-in tent sites, full hookups and a youth group camp.
places.notes: COORDINATES: TPWD page prints Latitude 28.133503, Longitude -96.984280 (used). Wikipedia point 28.13500, -96.98694 is about 0.3 km away and agrees. ACRES 321.4 and COUNTY Aransas from the Wikipedia infobox. CAMPING: TPWD campsites tab lists bayfront electric sites (20/30/50 amp), electric sites, walk-in tent-only sites up to 150 yards from parking, a youth group camp (sponsored nonprofit youth groups only), and premium full-hookup sites that are not reservable in advance. Overflow sites are self-contained units only. DARK SKY and LP: null, see Atlanta notes.

places.name: Lake Casa Blanca International State Park
places.blurb: Lakeside RV camping with full hookup and electric sites beside a 1,680-acre reservoir near Laredo.
places.notes: COORDINATES: TPWD page prints Latitude 27.539343, Longitude -99.451383 (used). Wikipedia point 27.53944, -99.45139 agrees (about 0.1 km). ACRES 525 and COUNTY Webb from the Wikipedia article. The 1,680-acre figure on the TPWD page is the reservoir, not the park. CAMPING: TPWD campsites tab lists Full Hookup sites (10 sites in Areas J and N; monthly reservations not allowed there) and electric sites. No tent sites appear on that tab, so camping_kinds is rv_hookups only. NEARBY: only Laredo is verified with coordinates; I did not find a second nearby item with a coordinate I could verify. DARK SKY and LP: null, see Atlanta notes.

places.name: Martin Creek Lake State Park
places.blurb: Lakefront electric sites, a walk-in island of primitive camping and screened shelters on Martin Creek Lake.
places.notes: COORDINATES: TPWD page prints Latitude 32.277950, Longitude -94.566051 (used). Wikipedia point 32.27806, -94.56611 agrees (about 0.2 km). ACRES 286 from the Wikipedia infobox. COUNTY Rusk from the Wikipedia article. CAMPING: TPWD campsites tab lists Screened Shelters, Group Sites, electric 30-amp lakefront sites, electric 50-amp and 30-amp sites, and primitive island sites (walk in about 200 yards, reached by a wooden bridge, no water or restrooms). Group camping is not confirmed as overnight, so 'group' is omitted. DARK SKY and LP: null, see Atlanta notes.

places.name: Pedernales Falls State Park
places.coord_point: official TPWD park coordinates (2585 Park Road 6026, Johnson City, TX)
nearby: Lyndon B. Johnson NHP, LBJ Ranch district (22 mi)
Enchanted Rock State Natural Area (36 mi)
places.blurb: Hill Country river park with electric campsites, horse sites and a hike-in backcountry camp at Wolf Ridge.
places.notes: COORDINATES: TPWD page prints Latitude 30.308054, Longitude -98.257649 (used). Wikipedia point 30.30000, -98.24167 is about 1.8 km away, inside the 2 km tolerance; official point used. ACRES 5,211.7 and COUNTY Blanco from the Wikipedia article. CAMPING: TPWD campsites tab lists a horse site, a group site, electric sites (30-amp, water and electric), and hike-in backcountry primitive sites at the Wolf Ridge camping area (about 2 mi from the parking area, no open fires, no potable water, check in at the office). Group camping is not confirmed as overnight, so 'group' is omitted. DARK SKY: not on the DarkSky pages I could read (see Atlanta notes). NEARBY: the LBJ distance is measured from the Wikipedia LBJ point, not from the Johnson City visitor area.

places.name: Stephen F. Austin State Park

places.blurb: Historic San Felipe park with full-hookup RV sites, water tent sites, walk-in primitive camping and a group camp.
places.notes: COORDINATES: TPWD page prints Latitude 29.811982, Longitude -96.108059 (used). Wikipedia point 29.81694, -96.10972 is about 0.6 km away and agrees. ACRES 663.3 and COUNTY Austin from the Wikipedia article. CAMPING: TPWD campsites tab lists Full Hookup sites (RVs or pop-up campers only, up to two tents beside the unit), tent-only Campsites with Water (up to three tents per site, no RVs or generators), primitive walk-in sites (no RVs), Group Camp 1 (open area, $5 excess-vehicle fee past 15 vehicles), and a Screened Shelters heading. places.name: Lyndon B. Johnson National Historical Park
places.coord_point: Wikipedia park-wide point (GNIS-derived), in the LBJ Ranch district near Stonewall. NOT the Johnson City visitor center (not verified)
nearby: Enchanted Rock State Natural Area (21 mi)
places.blurb: Johnson's boyhood home in Johnson City and the Texas White House ranch on the Pedernales, now a DarkSky Place.
places.notes: COORDINATES: NPS pages I read (index, planyourvisit/directions, management) print no latitude or longitude, so the only coordinate is Wikipedia's park-wide point 30.24083, -98.62417. That point sits in the LBJ Ranch district, about 13 mi from the Johnson City visitor center and park headquarters, so it is not the visitor center. Replace it with the NPS visitor-center point if one is found. ACRES: Wikipedia says present holdings are about 1,570 acres. The NPS management page says the park grew to 'an area of 674 acres' (sentence cut off in the fetch); that figure may refer to the Johnson City units, so the two need checking. COUNTY: Johnson City visitor area is in Blanco County; the LBJ Ranch district is in Gillespie County (Stonewall). CAMPING: false is an inference. The NPS index and directions pages name no campground, and the NPS camping page (planyourvisit/camping.htm) returned 404. Verify on the NPS park page. DARK SKY: DarkSky place page 'Designated 2021' under the Parks category; the exact tier wording was not captured, so 'International Dark Sky Park' is the label used. NEARBY: distances are great-circle from the Wikipedia point. From Johnson City itself Pedernales Falls is about 9 mi.

places.name: McClellan Creek National Grassland
places.coord_point: Lake McClellan Campground (official Forest Service campground point), Gray County, TX. The Black Kettle and McClellan Creek district office is in Cheyenne, OK, outside Texas, so it is not used
places.blurb: Lake McClellan campground on a Panhandle grassland, with single sites and electric hookups; the lake often runs dry.
places.status_note: Forest Service campground page says Lake McClellan is currently dry and the lake is prone to drought. Call the Black Kettle Ranger District at 580-497-2143 for conditions.
places.notes: COORDINATES: the Lake McClellan Campground page prints Latitude 35.21191914, Longitude -100.87377157 (used). Wikipedia's grassland point 35.2107, -100.8689 is about 0.5 km away; the official campground point is used. ACRES 1,449 from the Forest Service page (matches Wikipedia). COUNTY Gray from Wikipedia. The FS recreation page for the grassland lists eight sites including three campgrounds (Lake McClellan Campground, East Bluff #1, McDowell). CAMPGROUND: the FS campground page lists 60 camping units, single site $10 per night, single site with electric hookup $15 per night, day use $5 per vehicle, a vault toilet and potable water, year round, and a pay station (cash or check) with no reservations named. Third-party listings give 23 to 24 sites; the FS page is treated as authoritative. Directions on the FS page: 18 mi east of Groom on I-40, exit 128, then 3 mi north on FM 2477. Nearest town: Alanreed is about 8 mi by great-circle; the FS page says 'near Pampa' and Pampa is 24 mi. Lake Meredith NRA is about 52 mi away and is excluded from the nearby list. DARK SKY and LP: null, see Atlanta notes.
